goal: Based on Stephen Curry in REFERENCE_0, retain recognizable facial structure and body proportions, switching the overall look to a cyberpunk street night scene, single portrait output.

target_style: Cyberpunk (rainy night, neon, thin fog, electronic graffiti)
hair: Wet look black short stick-on hair, shaved short on the sides with gradient, tips reflecting a slight blue light
makeup: Subdued pale purple environmental reflection below the eyes, no heavy makeup, retaining male skin texture pores
outfit: Black gray detachable hooded windbreaker, with cross fluorescent cyan woven straps on the chest, diagonal small bag strap, and deep-colored compression wear underneath
accessories: Single-ear sports wireless earphones, narrow square reflective sunglasses hanging at the collar, breathable wrist support on the wrist, full face covered without a mask
scene: New scene: A crossroad under a viaduct after rain, with blurred neon signs mixing Chinese characters and English in red and blue, flooded ground reflecting car lights, distant red navigation lights of a drone, with light mist that does not obscure the face.
lighting: Main light comes from the left front purple screen and right back cyan light box, creating crossed color edges near cheekbones and nose bridge, with slight cyan fill light at the chin, contrast moderate to high but facial details readable
rendering: High resolution cinematic still photography, with slight dehazing and grain, skin tone not tinted unnatural magenta

constraints.must_keep: 脸型、五官相对位置、年龄段与可识别为 Stephen Curry
